name: Frame Rate Skill
purpose: Lift a 30 fps film to 60 fps or higher and make its motion smoother: re-render studio projects natively at the new rate after auditing what still strobes or stays at 30 fps, and interpolate any other finished film per gap (copy, blend or motion-compensated) from a leave-one-out probe measured on the film itself.
capabilities: Path choice: native re-render for studio projects, measured interpolation for finished films, native 60 then 60 -> 120 above 60
Gap filling rules: holds, cuts and stepped motion copied; dissolves blended; motion blended or motion-compensated by measured evidence
Smooth-motion craft at 60 fps: strobe threshold per frame, ease peak speeds, page motion blur, transitions
Verification: frame count, duration, audio, distinct frames per second, labelled contact strips

compatibility.notes: Instructional skill over scripts/frame-rate.py and src/pipeline/framerate.py. Calibrated on the Windows host (FFmpeg 9.0.2) only; not yet run on the M2.

licensing.notes: Workspace-authored. Motion craft rules paraphrased (ideas, no code) from the HyperFrames motion notes (Apache-2.0) shipped with the hyperframes install.

security.notes: Instructional guidance only; the tool record covers execution.

approval_evidence: Not yet approved: exercised on 2026-11-25 on the Windows host (one real 24 s film converted and inspected, a synthetic ground-truth scene, tests/test-frame-rate.py). No native 60 fps studio build and no M2 run yet.
